verdict.rationale: Mastra's own site claims agent threads can subscribe to external resources, with webhook events routed into notification signals. This directly matches the story's event-subscription capability, but it rests on a single landing-page line with no supporting depth. Missing for 10: detailed docs on registering webhook/trigger subscriptions, a list of supported downstream app integrations, confirmation that delivery is push-based rather than Mastra polling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them

citations.quote: Subscribe agent threads to external resources and route webhook or polling events into notification signals.
